endorsements.name: Tsutomu Aramaki
endorsements.label: CVE-2022-1749
endorsements.description: The WPMK Ajax Finder WordPress plugin is vulnerable to Cross-Site Request Forgery via the createplugin_atf_admin_setting_page() function found in the ~/inc/config/create-plugin-config.php file due to a missing nonce check which allows attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts, in versions up to and including 1.0.1.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: HIGH (CVSS 3.1, 8.8)

povs.explanation: A published CVE record provides public, independently verifiable recognition of the credited vulnerability disclosure.

endorsements.name: Tsutomu Aramaki
endorsements.label: CVE-2022-1969
endorsements.description: The Mobile browser color select plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Cross-Site Request Forgery in versions up to, and including, 1.0.1. This is due to missing or incorrect nonce validation on the admin_update_data() function. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject malicious web scripts via forged request granted they can trick a site administrator into performing an action such as clicking on a link.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: HIGH (CVSS 3.1, 8.8)
